mapper.insert: INSERT INTO insurances (insurance_type_id, policy_number, insured, expiry_date) VALUES (#{insuranceTypeId}, #{policyNumber}, #{insured}, #{expiryDate})
mapper.select: SELECT id, insurance_type_id AS insuranceTypeId, policy_number AS policyNumber, insured, expiry_date AS expiryDate FROM insurances WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, insurance_type_id AS insuranceTypeId, policy_number AS policyNumber, insured, expiry_date AS expiryDate FROM insurances
